🏙️ APARTMENT WANTED IN BUSINESS BAY, DUBAI

Looking for an apartment for 4 people, from October 29th to November 10th.

📍 Business Bay, Dubai
🛏️ 2 separate bedrooms
🚿 Preferably 2 bathrooms
💰 Budget: up to 8,000 RON for the entire stay

Looking for a clean apartment in a good location with good reviews.

Please send me photos, the final total price, and the apartment link if you have something available. Thank you! 🙏
